card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit 2 (or 5) right after an opening parenthesis that starts a section cross-reference, such as "( 2.1 )", in the highlights of drug labels. Also fires on digits inside standards citations like IEEE Std corrigendum numbers.

modes.label: Label section references
modes.description: The first digit of a section number in parentheses at the end of a highlights statement.

modes.label: Standards citation numbers
modes.description: Digits inside IEEE or ISO standard and corrigendum identifiers.

card.plain: It marks the number in a bracketed section reference, like the ones that point to another part of a drug label.
